title: Prayer for St. Teresa's Intercession
text:
O glorious St. Teresa,
seraphic virgin, beloved spouse of thy crucified Lord,
thou who on earth didst burn with the fire of divine love
and now dost glow with its perfect flame in paradise,
obtain for us from the most Sacred Heart of Jesus
that spark of heavenly fire which will enkindle in our cold hearts
a true love of God.

By thy powerful intercession,
may we be granted the grace to love our Lord
with something of the intensity with which thou didst love Him,
so that like thee we may be found worthy
to join the ranks of his faithful spouses in heaven,
where we shall sing his praises for all eternity.
Amen.
attribution: Traditional Prayer to St. Teresa of Avila
notes: This traditional prayer asks for St. Teresa's intercession to help us grow in divine love. It emphasizes her mystical experiences and her burning love for God. St. Teresa wrote extensively about the stages of mystical prayer and is considered one of the greatest teachers on prayer in the Catholic tradition.
